text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan takes 1st place!
She has seized the title of strongest of her generation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... whew—.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That's true!
I completely forgot how strong Chan is!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even though you said you were bad at it, you still won!
That's our Aston Machan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So this is Aston Machan...!
I let my guard down; if only I had interviewed her beforehand...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I am Aston Machan.
Aston Machan is right here, you know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Truth be told,
I wondered how things would turn out at first."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because you weren't really looking at Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It was Machan who chose the sprint division.
I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected,
Vodka and Scarlet are formidable.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just having those two clash against each other
causes expectations for the race to skyrocket.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Then deeper and stronger than ever before.
I have to leave my mark,
the Aston Machan way."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...For now, it's the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Aston Machan suddenly began walking in the opposite direction of the inn we'd booked.
I hurry to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We are in Kyoto in the autumn.
We simply must take a commemorative photo with the autumn leaves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you coming too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I enjoyed the crimson-tinted streets of Kyoto together with Aston Machan.
